rows.phase_or_construction: Direct JANAF O-014 liquid reference, checked against the O-013 crystal function at the 2938 K transition.
rows.method: Use the O-014 liquid standard and JANAF Sr(l)/O2(g) standards; the crystal/liquid transition gives ΔSfus=25.63386 J mol^-1 K^-1 and ΔHfus=2938 K×ΔSfus=75.3108 kJ mol^-1. The 66.944 J mol^-1 K^-1 liquid Cp and direct liquid table are retained.
rows.uncertainty_note: No row-specific numerical accuracy band is claimed. Associate fusion entropy and liquid Cp estimates are flagged provisional; battery activity observations are report-only.

rows.phase_or_construction: Rhodonite-composition liquid association standard constructed from measured SrSiO3 crystal thermochemistry and the measured congruent melting point.
rows.method: At Tfus=1853.15 K extend the measured 1000 K crystal Cp=129.226 J mol^-1 K^-1 as constant; use ΔSfus=5 atoms×8.297530569=41.48765 J mol^-1 K^-1 and Cp_liquid=66.944+85.772=152.716 J mol^-1 K^-1. H_l(T)=H_s(Tfus)+TfusΔSfus+Cp_l(T−Tfus); S_l(T)=S_s(Tfus)+ΔSfus+Cp_l ln(T/Tfus). Units give J/mol and J/(mol K); at Tfus, G_l=G_s. Sanity G(1853.15 K)=−2017.327 kJ/mol.
rows.uncertainty_note: No row-specific numerical accuracy band is claimed. Associate fusion entropy and liquid Cp estimates are flagged provisional; battery activity observations are report-only.

rows.phase_or_construction: Aluminate liquid association standard built by a Hess cycle from the assessed high-temperature SrAl2O4 crystal Gibbs function and an assessed fusion marker.
rows.method: Hf298(cr)=−592.036−1675.692−79.2=−2346.928 kJ/mol. At Tfus=2233 K, Ye et al. give Gcr=G(SrO,cr)+G(Al2O3,cr)−79.2 kJ/mol; use component JANAF enthalpy/entropy and ΔSfus=7×8.297530569=58.08271 J mol^-1 K^-1. Cp_liquid=66.944+192.464=259.408 J mol^-1 K^-1. Use the same H_l/S_l fusion equations; at Tfus, G_l=G_cr. Units check: Hess offset kJ/mol; TΔS and CpΔT are J/mol before conversion. Sanity G(2233 K)=−3002.667 kJ/mol.
rows.uncertainty_note: No row-specific numerical accuracy band is claimed. Associate fusion entropy and liquid Cp estimates are flagged provisional; battery activity observations are report-only.

derivation.premise: JANAF O-013 and O-014 share the 2938 K crystal/liquid marker.
derivation.algebra: ΔSfus=S_l(Tm)−S_cr(Tm); ΔHfus=TmΔSfus. For T away from Tm, G_l(T)=G_s(Tm)−S_s(Tm)(T−Tm)+ΔHfus(1−T/Tm)+Cp_l[(T−Tm)−T ln(T/Tm)].
derivation.units_check: TΔS is J mol^-1; Cp terms are J mol^-1; ΔHfus=75.3108 kJ mol^-1.
derivation.sanity_value: At 2938 K the liquid and crystal Gibbs functions coincide; 75.3108 kJ/mol differs by 0.3108 kJ/mol from the Handbook entry value 75.00 kJ/mol.

SrSiO3(l).fusion_temperature_source: 1580 ± 15 °C from Fields et al.; Eskola Table I independently lists 1580 °C.

derivation.premise: Measured crystal ΔfH°, S and Cp through 1000 K; use the measured congruent Tfus and explicitly estimate only high-temperature crystal continuation, fusion entropy and liquid Cp.
derivation.algebra: H_s(Tm)=Hf298+Hinc1000+Cp1000(Tm−1000)/1000; S_s(Tm)=S1000+Cp1000 ln(Tm/1000). ΔSfus=5×8.297530569. Cp_l=Cp(SrO(l))+Cp(SiO2(l)). H_l=H_s(Tm)+TmΔSfus+Cp_l(T−Tm); S_l=S_s(Tm)+ΔSfus+Cp_l ln(T/Tm); G_l=H_l−TS_l.
derivation.units_check: H and G in kJ/mol after converting J/mol by 1000; entropy in J/(mol K).
derivation.sanity_value: Hinc_s(Tm)=190.225 kJ/mol; S_s(Tm)=308.800 J/(mol K); ΔHfus=76.883 kJ/mol; G_l(Tm)=−2017.327 kJ/mol.

derivation.units_check: H and G in kJ/mol after converting J/mol by 1000; entropy in J/(mol K).

SrAl2O4(l).fusion_temperature_source: Ye et al. assessment 2233 K; competing reported values 2063, 2238 and 2288 K in Table 4.

derivation.premise: Use Ye et al. high-temperature crystal Hess relation from 932 to 2233 K, based on measured SrAl2O4 formation from oxides, with JANAF component crystal functions.
derivation.algebra: Hf298=−592.036−1675.692−79.2=−2346.928 kJ/mol. G_s(Tm)=G_SrO,cr+G_Al2O3,cr−79.2 kJ/mol; S_s(Tm)=S_SrO,cr+S_Al2O3,cr. ΔSfus=7×8.297530569; Cp_l=Cp(SrO(l))+Cp(Al2O3(l)); apply H_l, S_l and G_l fusion equations.
derivation.units_check: Hess offset is kJ/mol, JANAF Hinc is kJ/mol, and TΔS/CpΔT convert from J/mol to kJ/mol.
derivation.sanity_value: At 2233 K the source Hess cycle gives G_s=G_l=−3002.667 kJ/mol; ΔHfus=129.699 kJ/mol.
